subject: Invoice on-ramp: PO arrival & invoice timing for Q2 bookings recognition
messages:
From: Alex Coleman <acme.procurement@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 78921 (Redwood Inference) - ETA and billing details

Hi Vanessa,

Attached is the official purchase order (PO #78921) for the Q2 commitment. Key details:
- PO date: 2028-03-28
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bill-to: Acme Corporation, Accounts Payable (ap@acme.com)
- Total committed value: $240,000
- Requested invoice cadence: Net30 from invoice date

We expect the signed PO to be fully routed by the end of day 2028-03-29 (internal approvals are finishing). Please confirm the invoice recipient and any required invoice reference (e.g., order code) so AP can process without delays.

Attachment: ACME_PO_78921.pdf (PO scan)

Thanks,
Alex Coleman
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Coleman <acme.procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 78921 (Redwood Inference) - ETA and billing details

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clarity on timing. Looping in Evelyn (finance lead for this account) and Ben (billing operations) to confirm the invoicing path and revenue recognition timing. A couple quick points:

- Suggested invoice "bill-to" contact: ap@acme.com (please include the PO number in the invoice reference).
- Is Acme expecting the initial invoice to cover the full committed value or an initial milestone invoice?
- Will the signed PO be delivered as a PDF to our billing mailbox or via your DocuSign/ERP system?

We want to avoid any cutoffs that would delay bookings recognition for Q2. Current internal cutoff for April recognition is end-of-day 2028-03-31 for invoices to be processed in the April close. If the PO arrives 3/29 as planned we should be able to include the booking in April close assuming invoice flows within NetSuite by COB 3/31.

Evelyn / Ben — can you confirm the steps you'll need and if you foresee any gap given the dates above?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 78921 (Redwood Inference) - ETA and billing details

Thanks for the heads up, Vanessa — copying the plan below so we have an internal record and clear action items.

Summary / dependencies:
- PO expected 2028-03-29 (external). We have the PO scan attached from Alex, but need the official routed copy into our billing mailbox (billing@redwood.ai) or the DocuSign envelope to generate the invoice.
- Close target for Q2 booking recognition: April close (we treat invoices processed in NetSuite by 2028-03-31 COB as eligible for April booking window).
- If invoice cannot be posted by COB 3/31, we will need a commit review and leadership approval to move the recognition into May — that requires a documented commit note in our forecast.

Action items (owners):
1) Vanessa: confirm whether Acme will send final PO via DocuSign link or attach it to an email to ap@redwood.ai (due 2028-03-29 EOD).
2) Ben: if we receive PO + invoice by 3/29, please prioritize NetSuite entry and mark the revenue recognition date as 2028-04-05 (so bookings appear in April close).
3) Evelyn (me): I will prepare a short commit memo for finance close if there is any slippage; will escalate to finance leadership only if Ben flags processing issues.

Notes/risks:
- We need the invoice to reference PO#78921 exactly — mismatch in PO number or bill-to will cause AP rejection and push recognition into May.
- If Acme issues a milestone invoice schedule instead of full value, confirm which milestones map to which recognition dates; we may need to split the booking.

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-12345 (deal workspace with docs and contract)

Evelyn Hart
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 78921 (Redwood Inference) - ETA and billing details

All — quick update after checking our billing queue and the PO scan: we can hit the April recognition window provided we get the final routed PO and the supplier invoice no later than EOD 2028-03-30 (our NetSuite team needs ~8 business hours to post and code before the accounting close). Expected steps:

- If Acme emails the signed PO to billing@redwood.ai, Billing Ops will create the AR record same day and push for invoice generation (owner: Ben).
- If Acme sends a DocuSign envelope with an auto-forward to our billing mailbox, confirm DocuSign includes the PO number on the generated PDF (owner: Vanessa to confirm with Alex).
- On receipt, I will tag the transaction with recognition date 2028-04-05 and add a line to the April commit memo.

If any of the above slips (PO or invoice received 2028-03-31 or later), we will need to route a formal commit exception — Evelyn, please flag to finance leadership and we will prepare the backup memo (include HubSpot deal ID and PO PDF).

Action items now:
- Vanessa: confirm PO delivery mechanism to Alex (complete)
- Alex / Acme: please email final routed PO to billing@redwood.ai OR send DocuSign with auto-forward (due 2028-03-29 EOD)
- Ben: stand by to fast-track NetSuite entry on receipt

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
